acceptedAnswer.text: A detached Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a separate residential structure on the same property as a primary home. It provides independent living facilities, including a kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area. Building a detached ADU can significantly increase property value and provide flexible living space for family, guests, or as a rental unit. Hometelligent specializes in designing and constructing these standalone units to integrate seamlessly with your existing property in areas like Alameda and Berkeley.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached ADU is a separate residential structure on your property with its own living facilities, kitchen, and bathroom. It offers flexible space for family or rental income.
